channel.title: DIY Home
channel.description: Practical buying guides for everyday upgrades.

item.title: How do you choose a wallpaper smoothing tool?
item.description: Check the wallcovering manufacturer’s recommended applicator before buying. Compare edge shape and stiffness, then try the tool on a scrap. Plan how you’ll reach inside corners and trim around outlets before starting.

item.title: Adhesive or screw mount: what fits your kitchen?
item.description: Measure a full roll, including room to slide it on and off. Open the neighboring cabinet door and check what it would hit. Compare the maker’s surface and mounting instructions with your cabinet finish and lease restrictions.

item.title: Will a cookware rack fit your cabinet?
item.description: Measure the usable cabinet opening, not just the outside width. Include hinges and shelf lips. Lay out your largest pan and lid with their handles extended, then compare that footprint with the rack’s documented limits.
